The '''Bseto system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It contained the [[White dwarf/Legends|white dwarf]] [[Bseto]] and the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Bseto I]], [[Indikir]] and [[Sarahwiee]]. In between Indikir and Sarahwiee was the [[Lweilot Asteroid Belt]].
